**Tier 10.** Its `application`, `domain` and
`infrastructure` may import only a strictly lower tier. `http/` composes freely
but may never reach into another module's `http/` or `infrastructure/`.

May import: `account`, `activity`, `auth`, `cart`, `catalog`, `chat`, `checkout`, `commerce`, `contact`, `customers`, `delivery`, `identity`, `invoicing`, `loyalty`, `messaging`, `orders`, `payments`, `plugins`, `settings`, `shipping`, `vintedReviews`, `vouchers`.

Currently imports: `activity`, `cart`, `catalog`, `commerce`, `customers`, `delivery`, `identity`, `messaging`, `orders`.

Feature map entry: `gift` in [docs/features.json](../../../../../../docs/features.json). Run `npm --prefix tuucho/kernel/back run feature -- gift` for its full span.

## Invariants

<!-- invariants:start -->

A gift offer has one receiver and one giver, and the receiver never sees prices
unless the offer says so. The budget rules in `domain/remaining.ts` decide what
the receiver may select; a null accessory budget means accessories are
forbidden, not unlimited.

The PIN gate is a brute-force brake, not an authorization: the token in the URL
is what authorizes, and the PIN only slows guessing. Its backoff is capped so a
persistent guesser cannot lock the real receiver out permanently.

<!-- invariants:end -->
